programme.title: 搖曳露營3
programme.desc: 第三季著重於獨旅與團體露營體驗於山梨靜岡等地展開富士山露營庭院露營賞櫻露營雨天露營穿梭吊橋之國體驗峭壁上的溫泉主角志摩凜騎著摩托車挑戰多座水壩與祕境吊橋，並在湖邊露營場與貓咪互動，享用熱騰騰的番茄義大利麵撫子則體驗單人小露營，品嚐水壩咖哩飯與生火腿奶油乳酪餅野外活動同好會的千明葵惠那前往山區露營，不僅傳承了領柴劈柴的社團傳統，葵更獲得了公路自行車女孩們最後圍繞著溫暖的篝火，品嚐蕎麥麵與墨西哥薄餅，笑談形狀像雞肉料理的富士雞五湖，期待更多露營時光

programme.title: 少年願望事務所
programme.desc: 少年願望事務所節目深入探討當代青少年所面對的親子關係金錢觀兩性問題與同儕互動等現實課題，並以輕鬆幽默的方式呈現，讓觀眾在討論嚴肅議題之餘，也能開懷一笑

programme.title: 歡迎光臨我的牧場
programme.desc: 歡迎光臨我的牧場從牧場小主人的視角，紀錄台灣 13 種不一樣的牧場生活！包括豬羊鹿馬，甚至少見的青蛙和鱷魚養殖場等，帶大家認識養育動物的基本知識看見在牧場長大的孩子，展現對自然與動物的喜愛，也熱情分享飼養心得

programme.desc: 第二季的開始，會?辦公桌下的監聽器亮了一下，離開總會後，見學長收到會長的訊息，偵探總會多名偵探遭到暗殺，組織被盯上了，剛剛那樣講是為了降低敵?戒?這學期起，?學?不能再正?光明經營偵探社，必須私下練兵，秘密為總會挑選菁英?中?..

programme.title: 歡迎光臨我的牧場
programme.desc: 歡迎光臨我的牧場從牧場小主人的視角，紀錄台灣 13 種不一樣的牧場生活！包括豬羊鹿馬，甚至少見的青蛙和鱷魚養殖場等，帶大家認識養育動物的基本知識看見在牧場長大的孩子，展現對自然與動物的喜愛，也熱情分享飼養心得

programme.title: 非常了不起
programme.desc: 打造氣勢威風的神殿場景，設計充滿挑戰的機關道具，閣有緊張刺激的尋寶劇情予孩子佇合作挑戰的過程當中，自然感受著輕鬆好耍趣味，會當增強學台語的興趣！這馬，大聲喝出咒語...熊來尬！一起成為 非常了不起的人！

programme.title: 練習生，衝一波!

programme.title: 海洋日記
programme.desc: 以孩子和海洋的互動為重點，用好奇和觀察的眼光陪伴孩子們的日常生活，讓孩子們在海洋中自由發展他們童趣的靈性

programme.title: 動滋達滋森之島
programme.desc: 動滋達滋森之島是一個專為3-6歲孩子們設計的體能節目，充滿創意遊戲和肢體活動，讓孩子們在玩耍中學習和成長

programme.title: 阿法積木拼拼樂
programme.desc: 透過擬人化的積木來教導幼兒拼寫英文字母字母世界裡充滿了各種有趣的小冒險小觀眾可透過歌曲聽故事和各種趣味活動自然而然地學會了拼讀

programme.title: 妙妙犬布麗第3季
programme.desc: 活潑可愛的布麗，想像力超豐富愛玩耍，熱愛在生活中探險，讓每天都是新奇的一天總是和妹妹賓果一起冒險，藉由玩遊戲克服恐懼與學習，盡情地探索世界！當媽媽去上班，爸爸就在家工作和照顧可愛的布麗和賓果，非常樂在其中，超級稱職的新時代爸爸爸爸常常利用開放式遊戲，讓姊妹倆快樂學習與享受生活，所以大家都超愛爸爸！

programme.title: 皮皮與波西2
programme.desc: 以每天發生的趣味故事朋友相處的日常生活為主，節目溫馨且富有寓意，充滿良善與啟發解決問題的能力

programme.title: 水果冰淇淋
programme.desc: 融合本土文化及價值觀的節目，由幼教老師及文字工作創作具新意的幼兒童話並向國內兒童文學作家邀稿，為節目量身訂做全新的童話故事由趙自強飾演水果奶奶，在說故事時提供不同的觀點，引領孩子進入故事的趣味天地

programme.title: 節氣x六感實驗室第2季
programme.desc: 身為一個地球人，了解氣候的變遷是人人必做的功課，中國古代的學者們也因此研究出各種曆法，其中被民間廣為使用且沿用至今的就是二十四節氣

programme.title: 搖曳露營3
programme.desc: 第三季著重於獨旅與團體露營體驗於山梨靜岡等地展開富士山露營庭院露營賞櫻露營雨天露營穿梭吊橋之國體驗峭壁上的溫泉主角志摩凜騎著摩托車挑戰多座水壩與祕境吊橋，並在湖邊露營場與貓咪互動，享用熱騰騰的番茄義大利麵撫子則體驗單人小露營，品嚐水壩咖哩飯與生火腿奶油乳酪餅野外活動同好會的千明葵惠那前往山區露營，不僅傳承了領柴劈柴的社團傳統，葵更獲得了公路自行車女孩們最後圍繞著溫暖的篝火，品嚐蕎麥麵與墨西哥薄餅，笑談形狀像雞肉料理的富士雞五湖，期待更多露營時光

programme.title: 換個爸媽過幾天
programme.desc: 這是公共電視全新的親子實境節目，一個小有衝突的親子關係，彼此都想改變現狀，透過一項社會實驗，讓小孩暫時離開爸媽，到接待家庭過幾天...可能發生什麼樣的故事呢?

programme.title: 蒙古游牧人生
programme.desc: 本系列紀錄片深入介紹三個蒙古遊牧民族-蒙古族查坦族和哈薩克族，他們的日常生活與動物的關係，以及面臨傳統生活方式改變的認同危機

programme.title: 練習生，衝一波!

programme.title: The TCUP Show
programme.desc: The TCUP Show是為3-6歲的兒童打造，節目描述未來世界的TCUP 和他的太空好友Noodle 穿越宇宙，展開各種冒險的故事一路上，他們學到許多新事物，認識了自己，也鬧出不少笑料！趕快一起來探險！

programme.title: 動滋達滋森之島

programme.title: 阿法積木拼拼樂

programme.title: 妙妙犬布麗第3季
programme.desc: 活潑可愛的布麗，想像力超豐富愛玩耍，熱愛在生活中探險，讓每天都是新奇的一天總是和妹妹賓果一起冒險，藉由玩遊戲克服恐懼與學習，盡情地探索世界！當媽媽去上班，爸爸就在家工作和照顧可愛的布麗和賓果，非常樂在其中，超級稱職的新時代爸爸爸爸常常利用開放式遊戲，讓姊妹倆快樂學習與享受生活，所以大家都超愛爸爸！

programme.title: 皮皮與波西2

programme.title: 水果冰淇淋
programme.desc: 融合本土文化及價值觀的節目，由幼教老師及文字工作創作具新意的幼兒童話並向國內兒童文學作家邀稿，為節目量身訂做全新的童話故事由趙自強飾演水果奶奶，在說故事時提供不同的觀點，引領孩子進入故事的趣味天地

programme.title: 神木島

programme.title: 越來越嗖鯊
programme.desc: 越來越嗖鯊！（Xu?t s?c）是公視兒少新住民語言學習節目--越南系列嗖鯊是越南語Xu?t s?c的諧音，也是厲害出色的意思收視觀眾由原本6-12歲的學齡兒童，擴大至家長老師以致於全民節目方向已不只為了要新二代學媽媽的語言，而是要認識台灣多數人的語言主持人-阮秋姮節目中扮演嗖鯊甜點坊老闆，其開朗熱心又有點調皮的個性，成為來店大小顧客解決問題的聊天對象，其和店員嗖鯊哥及來賓，產生有趣的互動，進而瞭解越南語言及文化

programme.title: 古典魔力客-穿越城市聽音樂
programme.desc: 跟著江老師和魔力客開啟瘋狂的多重宇宙之旅，來到各城市了解古典樂的故事背景吧！

programme.title: 搖曳露營3
programme.desc: 第三季著重於獨旅與團體露營體驗於山梨靜岡等地展開富士山露營庭院露營賞櫻露營雨天露營穿梭吊橋之國體驗峭壁上的溫泉主角志摩凜騎著摩托車挑戰多座水壩與祕境吊橋，並在湖邊露營場與貓咪互動，享用熱騰騰的番茄義大利麵撫子則體驗單人小露營，品嚐水壩咖哩飯與生火腿奶油乳酪餅野外活動同好會的千明葵惠那前往山區露營，不僅傳承了領柴劈柴的社團傳統，葵更獲得了公路自行車女孩們最後圍繞著溫暖的篝火，品嚐蕎麥麵與墨西哥薄餅，笑談形狀像雞肉料理的富士雞五湖，期待更多露營時光

programme.title: 富貴門
programme.desc: 沙富來羅嘉良父母早亡，貧困交加中把弟弟沙寶來馬國明帶大；為生存在馬來西亞當老千機緣巧合下，他盜用了卓祟禧私生子卓一鳴的身份，與視他為親弟弟的大哥卓一元呂良偉回到香港進入卓家，搖身一變成為豪門二少爺然而在他未冒認身分之前，曾邂逅卓家千金卓一心袁詠儀，並兩人互生情愫，這短暫的浪漫，讓卓一心痛苦不堪，即欲斬斷這假不倫戀卓家上下從未懷?沙富來身分，極力想補償這個受苦多年的兒子，讓沙富來得到他本來失落的家庭溫暖，也讓他享受著金錢和權力的巨大誘惑，漸漸陷入貪婪恐懼嫉妒的人性試煉...

programme.desc: 想成為生態達人嗎？喜愛悠遊山海叢林與動物昆蟲親近的小朋友別錯過囉！好好玩自然帶你一起揭開大自然的神秘面紗！

programme.title: 超級總動員 YOYO寶貝萬花筒
programme.desc: 主要剪輯自熱門兒童競賽節目超級總動員，內容聚焦於國小學童的體育競技團隊合作與才藝挑戰

programme.title: YOYO嘻遊記第11季
programme.desc: YOYO嘻遊記要帶著電視機前面的大朋友小朋友們，一起找尋台灣最好吃最好玩的地點！輕鬆有趣的節目內容，你千萬不要錯過喔！

programme.title: YOYO點點名第26季
programme.desc: 由大哥哥大姐姐帶著小朋友們一起唱唱跳跳，藉由朗朗上口的歌曲與簡單的肢體動作，讓小朋友和爸爸媽媽一起在唱跳之中促進親子間親密關係

programme.title: 就是要PLAY第3季

programme.title: 我的學校有夠酷
programme.desc: 跟著哥哥姐姐一起走進校園 體驗超有特色超有趣的學校生活

programme.title: POLI第2季
programme.desc: 3D電腦兒童教育動畫，透過主要波力，教導小朋友在生活中會遇到的危難情況，以及如何學習面對問題，啟發兒童的互助的精神和友情

programme.title: POLI第2季
programme.desc: 3D電腦兒童教育動畫，透過主要波力，教導小朋友在生活中會遇到的危難情況，以及如何學習面對問題，啟發兒童的互助的精神和友情

programme.title: 可愛巧虎島第15季
programme.desc: 描寫主角巧虎在她所處巧連智島的日常生活，以在如夢的世界中冒險作為學習契機，另包括與身邊親朋好友的糾紛以及生活情節

programme.title: 吉伊卡哇
programme.desc: 描述一群可愛小動物們的日常物語雖然有時會因?難受而難過與哭泣，但身旁有著心地善良與個性十足的朋友相伴，總能帶來歡樂

programme.title: 妙妙犬布麗第1季
programme.desc: 故事講述一隻叫作布麗的澳洲牧牛犬小狗，想像力無遠弗屆，喜歡在日常生活中進行玩心十足的探險，她和妹妹賓果藉著玩遊戲來克服恐懼，也嘗試扮演大人的角色，盡情地探索這個世界她們最愛的就是拖爸媽下水一起玩，尤其是老爸！每當媽媽琪琪回去上班的時候，爸爸班迪便留在家一邊工作一邊帶小孩，雖然他以為自己是一家之主，不過遊戲時間可是由女兒說了算其實家裡幾乎都是女兒在做主啦！

programme.desc: 經營雪濃湯店的單親媽媽朴善子（金海淑 飾），含辛茹苦將三個女兒撫養長大大女兒姜美善（裕善 飾）是標準的職業婦女，在蠟燭兩頭燒的職場與家庭間疲於奔命，不僅要應付強勢挑剔的婆婆，還得將年幼的女兒託付給娘家媽媽照顧二女兒姜美莉（金素妍 飾）是擁有高學歷與高薪的大企業行銷部長，為了不讓母親操心，美莉拚命工作，但在遇上新進職員韓泰柱（洪宗玄 飾）後，不僅感情迎來轉變，隱藏在身世背後與親生母親的複雜糾葛也逐漸浮上檯面小女兒姜美慧（金荷景 飾）曾是拿過文學獎的天才小說家，如今卻陷入漫長的創作低潮，只能暫時在媽媽的湯店裡幫忙打雜，尋找人生的下一個方向母女間時而爭吵時而相依為命的深厚羈絆，最堅強的後盾，就是媽媽?

programme.title: 桃花映江山
programme.desc: 北苑國公主姜桃花（孟子義 飾）千里迢迢來到大祈和親，卻慘遭設局陷害清白盡毀為了在危機四伏的異國苟活，桃花將錯就錯，嫁給了權傾朝野習慣獨行的冷酷左相沈在野（劉學義 飾），憑著一流的逢場作戲本領與極強的求生欲，展開驚心動魄的生存戰

programme.title: 我金子般的明星
programme.desc: 1990年代，奉清慈（嚴正化 飾）是韓國娛樂圈呼風喚雨的巨星，卻在事業巔峰之際遭遇意外，陷入長達25年的昏迷當她奇蹟般甦醒時，發現這世界早已天翻地覆，青春美貌不再，取而代之的是50歲的大媽外表...

programme.title: 我的女兒孝心
programme.desc: 將一生奉獻給家人的李孝心，本是田徑的明日之星，因代替拋家棄子的父親扛下養家重擔只好輟學孝心要照顧媽媽兩個哥哥和一個弟弟，她在江南的健身中心工作，每天一大早就開始為家人的生活奔走，不僅要做體力活，還得應付各種情緒，長期下來令她疲憊不堪這天，孝心決定自立門戶追求屬於自己的幸福生活，而家人們也該各自學習獨立了?

programme.title: 花甲少年趣旅行 吃喝玩樂全攻略
programme.desc: 這是一段花甲老熟肉與少年小鮮肉們，跨越大齡差距，結伴而行的明星青春旅行到底小鮮肉們想什麼？而老熟肉們又會怎麼玩？透過世代差異，激盪出觀眾意想不到的旅行火花！全台唯一全明星跨世代旅遊實境節目，紀錄跨世代的藝人們難忘的友情之旅！

programme.title: 全民星攻略

programme.title: 效廉出發吧！今天去哪玩
programme.desc: 全新型態與組合的旅遊綜藝實境節目:逗趣大叔-許效舜熱血青年-廖威廉兩人逍遙環島瘋玩台灣這是一段見證男人友誼的旅行,帶著簡單行囊 騎上熱血摩托車欣賞每個城鎮獨有的歷史人文,探索體驗每個地方的特色美食與生活,分享彼此人生故事,更彌足珍貴的是知己談心為彼此充電,有別其他旅遊美食節目的樂趣和放鬆

programme.desc: 經營雪濃湯店的單親媽媽朴善子（金海淑 飾），含辛茹苦將三個女兒撫養長大大女兒姜美善（裕善 飾）是標準的職業婦女，在蠟燭兩頭燒的職場與家庭間疲於奔命，不僅要應付強勢挑剔的婆婆，還得將年幼的女兒託付給娘家媽媽照顧二女兒姜美莉（金素妍 飾）是擁有高學歷與高薪的大企業行銷部長，為了不讓母親操心，美莉拚命工作，但在遇上新進職員韓泰柱（洪宗玄 飾）後，不僅感情迎來轉變，隱藏在身世背後與親生母親的複雜糾葛也逐漸浮上檯面小女兒姜美慧（金荷景 飾）曾是拿過文學獎的天才小說家，如今卻陷入漫長的創作低潮，只能暫時在媽媽的湯店裡幫忙打雜，尋找人生的下一個方向母女間時而爭吵時而相依為命的深厚羈絆，最堅強的後盾，就是媽媽?

programme.title: 是誰搞的鬼
programme.desc: 五個朋友意外造成死亡車禍，決定隱瞞事實發誓保密一年後，當時的所作所為又浮上檯面透過特地前來南港製作與1997年有關的連環殺人案節目的Podcaster黛樂，艾娃等人發現現正發生的事情與當年如出一徹，從丹妮卡收到一封沒有署名上面僅寫有我知道你去年夏天做了什麼的小卡開始，到被穿著雨衣拿著鐵鉤殺人的人追殺，艾娃等人在遭到殺手追殺時，轉向1997年南港大屠殺的倖存者求助...

programme.title: 洋片幕後趣
programme.desc: 洋片幕後趣

programme.title: 最初的晚餐
programme.desc: 麟太郎（染谷將太 飾）和姐姐美也子（戶田惠梨香 飾）?了父親（永瀨正敏 飾）的葬禮返回家鄉，在守靈夜開始之前，母親秋子卻（齊藤由貴 飾）取消了所有的餐點並親自下廚隨著秋子端出一道道熟悉的料理，全家人回想起20年前，新媽媽秋子帶著大哥哥舜（窪塚洋介 飾）加入後五人一起生活的點滴，無論是曾經一起出遊的快樂回憶或是為了習慣差異出現的種種摩擦，不僅讓麟太郎他們重新思考家人的定義，更想起15年前，哥哥舜在一夜之間離家後再也沒回家的往事

programme.title: 鯊人機器
programme.desc: 外星太空船進到地球，在汪洋中留下神秘太空探測器，竟被大白鯊誤食，演變成了一隻能咬下飛機的恐怖鯊人機器，看似一場西雅圖大街的屠殺即將上演

programme.title: 血客聯盟
programme.desc: 姍姆（凱倫吉蘭 飾）的母親史嘉蕾（琳娜海蒂 飾）是隸屬於神祕刺客組織事務所的頭號殺手，但她卻突然拋下年幼的珊姆從此人間蒸發15年後，珊姆也成為事務所旗下的頂尖殺手，然而一次出錯的任務，讓她必須在對事務所保持忠誠或是保護無辜的8歲女孩之間做出抉擇

programme.title: 新解釋-三國志
programme.desc: 距今1800年前，中國大陸處於魏蜀吳三國群雄割據的時代在這亂世中，為重返太平盛世，被後人視為英雄的蜀國武將．劉備崛起，在劉備與各國武將們奔騰的熱血時代，終於發生了赤壁之戰，這是一場魏國80萬大軍對上蜀國與吳國的3萬聯軍的兵力懸殊之戰

programme.title: 魔物獵人
programme.desc: 本片根據CAPCOM熱門電玩遊戲改編，描述在人類居住的世界背後，有個充滿危險強大的魔物世界，娜塔莉阿特彌斯中尉蜜拉喬娃維琪 飾演與由她帶領的菁英部隊進入了這個神秘時空，在這個超能怪物群居的新世界，將面臨著全團滅亡的生存之際娜塔莉一行人在尋求返家之路時，她們遇到了一名能在這蠻荒之地生存的神秘獵人東尼嘉 飾演面對蜂擁而至的凶狠且恐怖的魔物攻擊，娜塔莉和勇士們準備一一擊退並找到能順利回家的路

programme.title: 特洛伊-木馬屠城
programme.desc: 特洛伊城的王子帕里斯把皇后海倫從斯巴達之王米奈勞斯身邊偷走，對他造成無法忍耐的羞辱他的哥哥邁錫尼之王阿伽門農就號召希臘各地出兵攻打特洛伊城，要把海倫搶回來勇猛的特洛伊王子赫克托領軍，和希臘第一武士的阿基里斯展開一場大戰成千上萬的人為了名譽而捲入戰局為了愛情，一個國家就此燒為灰燼

programme.title: 猛毒
programme.desc: 故事描述，身為外星共生體的猛毒因需寄託宿主才能生存，找上記者艾迪布洛克湯姆哈迪 飾演成為最新宿主，共生過程不僅賦與宿主超乎想像的強大能力，更將影響宿主的內心意識誓言調查真相的記者艾迪布洛克該如何才能與毒共存運用自己正邪交織的能力來以毒攻毒呢？

programme.title: 退休追殺令
programme.desc: 一位媽媽（艾希莉葛林飾）和她年幼的女兒莎拉（塔莉亞坎貝爾飾）捲入了犯罪集團的活動中面臨生命遭到威脅的情況，唯一能解救她的人，是跟她早已疏遠在開曼群島海灘享受退休生活的父親麥特（尼可拉斯凱吉飾）...

programme.title: 偷天盜日
programme.desc: 曾經的高中棒球金童漢克湯普森，雖然已經不在球壇打拼，不過生活還算過得去他有個很棒的女友，在紐約一間酒吧當調酒師，最愛的球隊也正在以黑馬之姿衝擊冠軍

programme.title: 盤索里拳手
programme.desc: 曾是拳擊界希望之星的前拳擊手炳久（嚴泰九 飾），卻在某瞬間遭拳擊協會永久除名在朴館長（金希沅 飾）的安排下，到他所經營的拳擊館工作，雖然炳久因此重燃拳擊之夢，但他被診斷罹患了Punch Drunk，這種疾病會出現在拳擊運動員身上，在頭部屢遭重擊後長期累積下來，會出現腦部受損症狀，如帕金森氏症等

programme.title: 分秒幣爭
programme.desc: 以1997年亞洲金融風暴期間韓國向國際貨幣基金組織申請援助而展開的談判為背景，敘述了三個獨立的故事

programme.title: 死不開除
programme.desc: 正恩（劉多仁 飾）在公司工作7年，突然被派遣到下游廠商工作正恩雖然想努力適應新環境，但職場同事令她感到十分不自在，讓她感到難以適應想在這裡撐到一年的正恩，在老么（吳正世 飾）的幫助下，漸漸適應這個環境一年的派遣人生，她為了存活而奮力一跳！

programme.title: 借來的100天
programme.desc: 一個遊蕩人世的靈魂，意外獲得重生的機會，借屍還魂住進一位泰國高中生小旻的身體展開一段新生活不如表面看起來輕鬆，試著融入新家庭新學校的過程中，也遇見讓人心跳加速的學伴小派然而這一切都是有期限的，他必須在100天查出小旻的神秘死因，屆時如未完成任務，他將魂飛魄散永不超生

programme.title: 緣來大飯店
programme.desc: 講述懷著各自的故事來到埃姆羅斯飯店（Hotel Emross）的人們，以各自的方式製造只屬於自己的緣分的故事

programme.title: 魔鬼剋星-冰天凍地
programme.desc: 史賓格勒一家在這集中，回到魔鬼剋星的發源地-前紐約消防局大樓，與第一代的隊員重逢，並期望最高機密的研究室能夠研發出更先進的抓鬼技術不過此時卻發現神秘的寒慄死神躲藏在數百年前的古老文物中被釋放了強大的寒冰能力將造成地球迎來第二次的冰河時期，並且釋放出關在研究室中的厲鬼們，魔鬼剋星必須團結一心聯手保護家園並且阻止世界末日的來臨

programme.title: 驚奇隊長
programme.desc: 原是空軍飛行員的卡蘿丹佛斯，在克里星球甦醒並失去了過往所有的記憶，她獲得驚人的超人力量，受軍隊的最高指揮官與導師揚羅格裘德洛 飾演指導，以克里人的身分戰鬥，與菁英軍事單位星際部隊成員共同對抗史克魯人的侵略；不過在最新的任務中，她為了抵抗外星入侵，意外到訪C-53星球的地球，與神盾局長尼克福瑞一起聯手尋找羅森博士的下落片中除了神盾局人員及局長不變定律山繆傑克森外，還多了許多新鮮面孔，如裘德洛陳靜（代表作品瘋狂亞洲富豪）和安妮特班寧，還有一隻非常有哏的橘貓

programme.title: 效廉出發吧！今天去哪玩
programme.desc: 全新型態與組合的旅遊綜藝實境節目:逗趣大叔-許效舜熱血青年-廖威廉兩人逍遙環島瘋玩台灣這是一段見證男人友誼的旅行,帶著簡單行囊 騎上熱血摩托車欣賞每個城鎮獨有的歷史人文,探索體驗每個地方的特色美食與生活,分享彼此人生故事,更彌足珍貴的是知己談心為彼此充電,有別其他旅遊美食節目的樂趣和放鬆

programme.title: 小姐不熙娣
programme.desc: 自帶女王氣勢的 IPSS 的女王小Ｓ，睽違六年強勢回歸！以女性出發點的節目議題，聚焦女性的職場與生活感受

programme.title: 夢想街57號-預約你的夢想
programme.desc: 提供最新最即時的新車資訊邀請汽車達人分享試車報告同時幫觀眾做最仔細的車款集評還有專家分享最實用最省錢的愛車維修撇步，甚至將難得一見的限量車改裝車等直接搬到棚內汽車節目，不再只是純座談的方式，而是將更專業更豐富更多元化的內容呈現給觀眾

programme.title: 我的眼裡只有你
programme.desc: 李盈怡（裴盧麗 飾）在丈夫過世後成為單親媽媽，白天在婆家經營30年的老牌牛骨湯店工作，晚上則到超商兼職，為女兒金美莉娜（尹採? 飾）努力存錢即便孤獨悲傷，盈怡也不輕易哭泣，直到遇見泰盛零售家族長孫張慶俊（白成鉉 飾）後，兩人的愛情羅曼史即將展開?

programme.title: 進擊的台灣
programme.desc: 進擊的台灣努力呈現出台灣社會各行各業小人物的故事，透過這些平凡人對生活工作的態度，讓觀眾見證他們不凡的精采人生期望以此高品質又能激勵人心的節目，與台灣民眾共同守護我們的一片淨土

programme.desc: 1930年，新來的日警因誤會和族人起衝突，自此馬赫坡社便活在恐遭日警報復的陰霾裡賽德克年輕人要求莫那魯道帶領他們反擊日本人，莫那清楚知道這是場必輸的戰役，更可能會滅族，但他決定挺身為民族尊嚴反擊，於是率領族內年輕人，準備奪回獵場

programme.title: KTV有鬼啊
programme.desc: 許多名人受邀參加辦在曼谷偏遠山區森林裡的一場派對，在派對現場，一台舊型卡拉OK機被擺放在最顯眼的角落蒞臨的來賓有人手癢，插上插頭準備開唱，卻突然出現一位穿著校服的年輕女鬼，手持斧頭並開始屠殺現場來賓僥倖沒死的來賓，也在她控制下要求唱歌，只要走音或忘詞就殺無赦！

programme.title: 西遊記之月光寶盒
programme.desc: 菩提老祖為了挽回自己的過失阻止兩人陰謀來到五嶽山，他說明至尊寶是孫悟空轉世，至尊寶不相信白骨精五百年前和孫悟空有一段糾纏不清的戀情，此時為了救至尊寶襲擊春三十娘，卻中毒受傷此時牛魔王殺到，二女不敵，挾持至尊寶和二當家逃回到盤絲洞春三十娘逼迫白晶晶殺掉至尊寶，卻反被二人關在機關春欲用迷情大法對付至尊寶，又錯用在二當家身上

programme.title: 小姐不熙娣:268
programme.desc: 自帶女王氣勢的IPSS 的女王小S，睽違六年強勢回歸！ 以女性出發點的節目議題，聚焦女性的職場與生活感受

programme.title: 全民星攻略:268
programme.desc: 用智慧掌握機會才能創造獨一無二的命運 全民星攻略智慧星幣翻倍賽 不變的是廣度與深度的知識含量

programme.title: 今晚開讚吧:272
programme.desc: 結合不同族群社團粉絲團民調排行榜合作！ 利用大數據分析，反應市場趨勢，精準抓出熱門關注話題！

programme.title: 花束般的戀愛
programme.desc: 在東京京王線明大前車站，因錯過末班車而偶然相遇的山音麥與八谷絹，因對音樂和電影等喜好太過相似，讓兩人瞬間墜入情網，在大學畢業後一邊打工一邊展開同居生活不管生活中發生什麼事，兩人都以維持現狀為目標，同時努力尋找正式的工作，就這樣不知不覺過了5年...

programme.title: 投名狀
programme.desc: 十九世紀中葉，舉世都在動盪變革中：歐洲德意志帝國成立；美國南北戰爭；日本明治維新；中國鴉片戰爭香港被割讓太平天國定都南京；風起雲湧，此起彼落時代的巨輪不會稍一止息，全世界在戰亂中走向現代，時勢造就了英雄的誕生，亦摧毀了人性的純真

programme.title: 新暫時停止呼吸
programme.desc: 靈幻道士英叔（林正英）的舊情人蓮妹，託其妹念英求援，師徒來到大帥府，見大帥身染屍毒，而身懷六甲的蓮，體中胎兒非常怪異，英發覺其褓姆並非常人，於是想引魔胎離開母體，加以消滅，但褓姆拼死護胎，英進退兩難之際，廣西殭屍群跟蹤而來，令眾人腹背受敵，一場殭屍魔胎的大戰就此展開...

programme.title: 賭城風雲3
programme.desc: 國際刑警發現石一堅與小馬名下的秘密戶口，有一筆DOA集團150億的?額匯款，懷疑兩人暗中奪走贓款而拘捕兩人之後，在陳刀仔高進的表妹高菲與龍五的兒子龍十五的救援行動下，兩人才得以逃出接著，易天行帶著手下金衣登門邀請陳刀仔與高進參加一場舉辦在泰國天堂島的慈善賭局，石一堅假扮成高進和陳刀仔一同前往後，居然發現他的摯愛莫愁出現在高科技研究室

programme.title: 警察故事續集
programme.desc: 皇家香港警察隊重案組警長陳家駒成功緝拿大毒梟朱滔搞垮其販毒集團後，卻因屢次違反上級命令嚴重破壞公物後遭到署長調職當交警期間，朱滔因身患絕症而只剩三個月生命，因此獲得保外就醫而走出法院，揚言要對家駒報復

programme.desc: 外號贏盡天下無敵手的石一堅，不單能摸出麻將點數，連撲克牌點數也能摸出來，他從美國賭城擔任保安總顧問退休回澳門老家，遇上當年好友Benz其兒子曬冷及外甥牛必勝，曬冷及牛必勝希望能跟這位傳奇人物拜師學藝，堅要曬冷騙倒他一次或贏他一次，才答應收為徒曬冷之同母異父兄長陳龍是臥底探員，一直潛伏於國際賭業犯罪組織，組織將全球外圍球賽博彩的黑幫聯合起來，操縱賽果，其開會過程被龍拍下，並將罪証內容藏於一隻假眼中，而這隻假眼輾轉落入堅的獨女彩虹手中，令原本退休的堅不得不再以魔術手佈下騙局解救危機

programme.title: 老狐狸

programme.title: 校園敢死隊

programme.title: 警察故事

programme.title: 警察故事續集

programme.title: 夏日樂悠悠

programme.title: 冥中注定我愛你

programme.title: 黃金48小時第26季
programme.desc: 對於凶殺案的刑警來說，最關鍵最重要的，就是最初的四十八小時這段時間往往決定了案件的成敗，一旦這條關鍵的時間線被突破而仍未找到任何線索，破案的機率便會被削減一半隨著時間一小時一小時地流逝，嫌疑人就有更多時間潛逃躲避追捕，而那些關鍵證據，也可能在不知不覺間被破壞遺失甚至永遠消失不見黃金48小時是一部充滿現實張力與真實感的紀錄劇，它節奏緊湊緊迫逼人，彷彿一場與時間賽跑的競賽刑警與凶殺小組的成員們夜以繼日，在每一起剛剛發生的命案現場中奮力追查，試圖在時限之內找出真兇揭開謎團

programme.title: 天天天晴:21
programme.desc: 龍福是本地名門石敢當集團旗下的珠寶店，在老闆娘明心安領導下，經歷九七回歸亞洲金融風暴沙士和金融海嘯等大大小小風波，由瀕臨結業至成為數一數二的珠寶店品牌精明的心深受店內員工及同行敬重，令人艷羨雖然風光背後事業和家庭各有隱憂，但樂觀的她積極面對，充滿正能量

programme.title: 踩過界2:24
programme.desc: 綽號盲俠的失明大律師文申俠（王浩信飾）擁有超強的四感，他聯同女師爺趙正妹（蔡思貝飾）私家偵探谷一夏（張振朗飾）為弱勢社群爭取公義，不惜採取踩界手法大律師邵美娜（張曦雯飾）主動接近申俠，二人及後會於法庭對壘，在美娜背後支援的還有其師父簡紹宏（秦沛飾） 申俠於多年前的實習期曾拜紹宏為師，期間卻因一宗無屍命案而師徒決裂；申俠提出新證據為被告上訴，與紹宏再次交鋒，引發連場惡鬥！美娜的出現，同時亦令申俠正妹一夏這個鐵三角組合的關係，產生微妙變化

programme.title: 翻生武林:10
programme.desc: 朝廷打壓武林，五大派被收編英雄名冊，交由東廠提督仇不群管治，江湖名存實亡，英雄不再！玉雲龍跟姐姐嬌鳳經營平安客棧，一直遠離武林中事但雲龍為奪舊愛艾冰冰芳心，決意逐鹿新晉英雄大賽，卻因揭發東廠黑幕被押入大牢嬌鳳為救雲龍，訛稱平安客棧暗藏異寶，招致各路隱世英雄齊集仇在心奉義父不群之命親近雲龍探查寶物，與雲龍漸生情愫，二人更無意中救出被困多年的武林盟主任我飛！沉睡多時的武林，可會因此翻生？

programme.desc: 朝廷打壓武林，五大派被收編英雄名冊，交由東廠提督仇不群管治，江湖名存實亡，英雄不再！玉雲龍跟姐姐嬌鳳經營平安客棧，一直遠離武林中事但雲龍為奪舊愛艾冰冰芳心，決意逐鹿新晉英雄大賽，卻因揭發東廠黑幕被押入大牢嬌鳳為救雲龍，訛稱平安客棧暗藏異寶，招致各路隱世英雄齊集仇在心奉義父不群之命親近雲龍探查寶物，與雲龍漸生情愫，二人更無意中救出被困多年的武林盟主任我飛！沉睡多時的武林，可會因此翻生？

programme.title: 震震有詞
programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.title: Sweet and Wild
programme.desc: With a twisted plot, mistaken identities, along with some terrific musical numbers, this comedy of errors featuring Li Ching is absolutely fabulous.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: After a guilty Alex confesses his affair to Tung, his injured wife, she somehow ends up living with Alexs mother and his mistress under the same roof!

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: An alluring female fairy seeks love among mortals and finds it in a man who takes care of an orphanage.

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: In this Flying Guillotine follow-up, a fearless woman Chen Ping takes on a flying guillotine gang even while shes pregnant!

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: The retired one-armed swordsman made his reappearance to fight against the brutal robbers and protect the peace of the martial art world.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: A follow-up to the previous blockbuster, this 60s musical features an unemployed magician whose love life is as twisted as his tricks.

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: In John Lo Mars masterpiece, an old medicine seller and his three apprentices learn Chinese, crane, pole, and drunken fighting to defeat an arrogant bully.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays a beauty tricked into sacrificing herself for the good of the Chinese people. However, the truth is revealed too late.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: Witness the exploits of Chan Chao an advocate of justice who thwarts the plans of Minister Peng to assassinate the revered Judge Pao Cheng over and over again.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: After Ah Niu moves to Hong Kong, a kind-hearted fellow from rural China is taken advantage by cunning characters including his uncle.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: From writer director Pan Lei comes this Chinese variation of Henry Kings famous 1950s film about a persecuted swordsman.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: Cheng Pei Pei stars as Hsiao-Yun, a young singer struggling to juggle her career and her relationship with her pianist lover.

programme.title: The Sword and the Lute
programme.desc: Kwei Wu and his partner go on a mission to destroy the Phoenix Lute, a deadly weapon that shoots poisonous needles and can only be destroyed by the Kan sword.

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: Director Li Han Hsiang adapts three erotic tales from Chinese classical literature for the silver screen. Starring Tien Lie, Hu Chin and Chen Ping.

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: In one of her first roles, Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon villain Cheng Pei Pei plays a kung-fu Nancy Drew who must face a secret serial killer.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: After a kung-fu master Lau Kar Leung is crippled by a ruthless villain, he teaches a boy monkey kung-fu to avenge his shame.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Its Shaolin versus corrupt Ching soldiers in Chang Chehs fun-filled kung-fu showcase, filled with show-stopping martial arts sequences.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: In veteran writer director Yueh Fengs most memorable martial arts movies, the luminous and lethal Shih Szu plays the title swordswoman.

programme.title: Hex After Hex
programme.desc: In this comedy, hellish emotions are unleashed when a demon arranges to have his true love killed in order to possess her. Starring Lo Meng.

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Award-winning actor Ku Feng plays the cunning pirate Lei Chen-tien, flanked by Wan Ping who disguises herself as a boy to beat him to the treasure.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: An insane swordsman takes to making Chinese lamps from the skin of his enemies sisters, mistresses and wives!

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: The Venoms bid a fond farewell to their internationally beloved film series with this saga about a building that bristles with booby-trapped blades.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: A chauffeurs daughter and the heir to a cruise ship conglomerate fall in love as they try to outwit greedy relatives who have sights on the company.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In this comedic sequel to the 36th Chamber of Shaolin, Gordon Liu is hired to impersonate the 36th Chambers founder!

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: In true Huangmei opera style, lovely Li Hsiang-chun stars as a used and abused beauty in director Kao Lis restrained, as well as sadistic tearjerker.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu, who is trying to shed his criminal side, instead finds himself caught up in an all-out gang war that comes to a startling conclusion.

programme.title: Leap
programme.desc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, former volleyball legend Lang Ping coached Team USA to a controversial win over China. She later returned to rebuild Chinas team and won gold at Rio 2016.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair
programme.desc: Based on the 1954 martial arts novel, this film details the tragic romance between wild swordsman Zhuo Yi-hang and rival cult assassin Lien Ni-chang, with a dark, erotic and visually stunning twist.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: In this screen adaptation of Louis Chas famous novel, Stephen Chow plays small time punk Wei Xiao Bao alongside an all-star cast.

programme.title: The Sunny Side of the Street
programme.desc: A Pakistani refugee receive help from a taxi driver after his father died in a car crash. They gradually develop a father-son relationship, until Hassan discovers the truth behind his fathers death.

programme.title: Golden Boy
programme.desc: Fallen boxing star Golden Boy Chang Li, after a decade in prison, must reconnect with the son he has never met. He rediscovers his purpose and returns to the ring to become the father his son deserves.

programme.title: Dead Talents Society
programme.desc: Newbie ghost Rookie must prove herself in the afterlife by delivering spectacular scares. A washed-up ghost diva and her agent help her battle to earn her haunting licence, or else she will vanish.

programme.title: P Storm
programme.desc: Ping reports a case of prison corruption to the ICAC. ICAC officer Luk goes undercover in prison to investigate and is determined to complete his mission with the help of his cell mate, Wang.

programme.title: Good Game
programme.desc: A desperate internet cafe owner recruits his daughter, a washed-up action star and a failed pro gamer to form a ragtag esports teamall for a HK500k tournament and one last, no-regrets shot.

programme.title: All Suspects
programme.desc: A policeman on leave checks into a BB with a detective novelist, a drifter and a pianist. When the owner and receptionist turn up dead, every guest becomes both suspect and sleuth...

programme.title: Guilt By Design
programme.desc: As a juror in a high-profile case learns that his daughter has been mysteriously kidnapped, he must decide whether to use his special skills to influence the trial as demanded by the kidnappers.

programme.title: Valley Of The Shadow Of Death
programme.desc: Years after his daughters tragic death from assault, the offender resurfaces in church to ask for forgiveness. Torn between his faith and humanity, Pastor Leung faces a profound test.

programme.title: A Murder Erased
programme.desc: Police officer Choi is assigned to a case where the body was undiscovered for 8 years. During the investigation, the prosecutor finds all inconsistencies suspicions fall on Choi.

programme.title: Back To The Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lived in seclusion for 20 years until a time traveller returned to rewrite history, forcing them to defend the Qin dynasty and fate itself.

programme.title: One and Only
programme.desc: A veteran and a passionate street dancer both strive to reach their goals and pursue their dreams in street dancing. After overcoming many challenges, can they finally shine on stage?

programme.title: Break Up Club
programme.desc: Jaycee Chan plays a 20-something slacker who discovers a magical website that may help reunite him and his girlfriend but at what cost?

programme.title: No One Like Me
programme.desc: Yang Qian Huan, once a golden boy, sees his glory fade after the birth of Xu Qi An. Yet, rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate.

programme.title: The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: A Hong Kong megastar decides to make a film about rural China to win an award at a film festival. He experiences village life for a farmers role, but this results in a series of hilarious events.

programme.title: True Love For Once In My Life
programme.desc: Sabrinas deep love for Andrew is shattered by his affair which ends their marriage. Years later, she returns to care for him as he is diagnosed with cancer, believing that true love comes only once.

programme.title: Schemes in Antiques
programme.desc: Despite his familys expertise in ancient Chinese relics, Xu Yuan resents their fraudulent ways. However, when fate shows him a route to redeeming their reputation, will he survive it?

programme.title: Cape No. 7
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer tries to deliver seven old love letters attentioned to a Tomoko. As he falls in love with a young Japanese model also named Tomoko, he unravels their serendipitous connection.

programme.title: Marriage with a Liar
programme.desc: Kiki and Sean, who have been together for seven years, betray each other three days before their wedding. Faced with perfect partners, they abandon their responsibilities and part ways.

programme.title: Relentless Fury
programme.desc: A mercenary team led by Captain Lin must protect a mysterious woman bearing the highest bounty in dark web history from global assassins, including an infamous fugitive in a deadly fight for survival.

programme.title: A Gilded Game
programme.desc: A finance interns rapid rise under a top analyst ends when he betrays his mentor for a rival. To redeem himself and stop a hostile takeover, he must seek help from the man he wronged.

programme.desc: Its Evil Peas birthday, but she and Carrot are trapped in the bottom of her freezer. They must put their differences aside and work together to escape.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer 1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hons pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer Li Ching, the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their masters birthday.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Huns warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named The Fastest Sword but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his bride use the deadly weapon - Phoenix Lute to fight against evil, but the lute accidentally falls into the hands of bandits hoping to use it to take control of the province. Gui Wu must now fight to recover the lute and beat the bandits.

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: This instant cult classic adapts three erotic and mystical tales from the Chinese classical works, with stories spanning across time from the Tang to Ming dynasties. The stories, filled with characters such as emperors, concubines, monks and fortune-tellers, intertwine in a world of adultery, lust and greed, alongside great costumes!

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during Chinas early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chens past insult.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hongs enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brothers death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular Venom Lo Meng.

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his fathers death. He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Longs wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock n roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of scaffolding kung fu.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parents consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu Da Jiang, a naive young man, is betrayed and hunted by his sworn brothers after a gold robbery goes wrong. Surviving against the odds, he gains the favour of a gang leader and embarks on a path of revenge with bodyguard Jin Yan. As rival gangs clash and feelings emerge, a violent underworld showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhangs custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called Kung Fu Stuntmen. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tians daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Lets Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husbands death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yis husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the Happy Spinsters Club set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperors eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Mans matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuks pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk an

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laikas mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Mins friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Mins death.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kongs brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous Gang Trio is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three Rob-B-Hood must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xins ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the students family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.desc: The Strutter siblings hold a yard sale and babysit at the same time. Archibald races for a big prize: a lifetime supply of his favorite cereal.

programme.title: Archibalds Next Big Thing S1 - The Chicken Has Landed The Night of the Nibbler
programme.desc: Archibald takes an unexpected trip to outer space. When a yummy recipe goes missing, Archibald P.I. sets out to crack the case.

programme.desc: Mother is determined to take the perfect family Christmas photo in the middle of the summer. With the help of a snow machine, Olivia takes it upon herself to bring a little Christmas spirit to the photograph, and to Francines backyard beach party next door.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia The Nature Photographer
programme.desc: After snapping some great photos of her cat Edwin, Olivia thinks shes ready to photograph some real wild animals. She and Julian camp out in the backyard to wait for some, and sure enough they track down a mysterious animal in the bushes. But is it really a wild beast?

programme.title: Olivia S1 - The Two Olivias
programme.desc: Theres a new girl in Olivias class and her name is...Olivia! Confusion ensues, and Olivia the original Olivia cant believe that she shares her name with another person. After a brief stint calling herself Pam, Olivia eventually decides that a two Olivia town might not be so bad after all.

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S1 - Pandys Birthday
programme.desc: Its Pandys birthday!! The dollhouse is throwing a surprise party for him! Gabby goes room to room preparing all his favorite things for the party, but when the big moment comes, Pandy drops his cake! Gabby consoles him and tells him its even better now, they have smash cake! They all hold up a piece and pose for a picture.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Glitter Guide Piano Panic
programme.desc: When the Dews find out their glitter guide an older Dew Drop is coming to visit, they bend over backwards to make a great first impression, but end up forgetting some of their responsiblities in the process. When a string breaks on Marcus piano before his recital and he cant practice, the Dews must lead Marcus to a new piano.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Dew Drops Day Off Up All Night
programme.desc: When the Dew Drops have the day off, they discover their families still need their help when theyre not around. Harper needs a good nights sleep before her first day of Cooking Camp. But when an overtired Nicholas keeps her awake, the Dews must help keep Nicholas quiet, even if it takes all night.

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S2 - Gabby, I Shrunk the Kitties!
programme.desc: Gabby and Pandy accidentally get turned teeny-tiny when one of Mercats potions spills. To get back to their normal size, they need to find the right ingredients to make a grow potion, which means going on an itty-bitty search through the dollhouse! For our Cat of the Day segment, Mercat shows us how to make sparkly, mermaid slime.

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S2 - Its Purrsday!
programme.desc: Its Purrsday, the happiest cat day of the year, and all the Gabby Cats have a special purrsday surprise. Gabby and Pandy make peekaboo kitty paper chains with Baby Box, decorate a Purrsday cake with Cakey, Gabby gets a special kitty makeover with Mercat, and everyone sings a Purrsday song with DJ Catnip. For the COTD, DJ Catnip shows us how to make a DJ Catnip purr-stick!

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - CupKate

While on a no-holds barred quest to get Kate her favorite cupcakes, Melman learns the gift doesnt matter, as long as it comes from the heart.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Pest Side Story
programme.desc: Gloria becomes determined to earn her Queen of Kindness Kidizen badge and welcomes some free-spirited rats who need a place to stay into the habitat. Despite her discomfort, Gloria encourages the rats to make themselves at home. When the rats play with her special baby tusk at the bottom of her tank, she finally snaps and sends the rats home. programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Spinny Water Kelps Song
programme.desc: Kelp and his underwater friends race around an obstacle course, but Cruz gets sucked into a whirlpool. As each of them try to rescue him, they are sucked in! Kelp saves them all using his unicorn spark to create bubbles he attaches to seaweed. Kelp helps his unicorn friends create music with their horns and pieces of nature. Ollie is embarrassed by the sound of his horn.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Playground Sparkless
programme.desc: Cruz decides to turn the sunken ship into a park. But all his and Kelps fun-crastinating puts the project in jeopardy. Kelp accidentally knocks a boulder into the stream, blocking the flow while trying his unicorn spark. Frustrated by magic, Kelp uses the narwhal way.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Chaser And Chewer Recipe For Adventure

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Rodney the Hero Club Shed
programme.desc: When Rodney accidentally catches Sam when she falls from a tree and starts to believe hes a hero TZG secretly follow him around town to make sure his clumsy hero-ing doesnt go wrong. When Lula and Luis want a clubhouse for the Squasher Fan Club, TZG secretly help fix up the shed in Luis backyard.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - It Takes a Zenko What a Racket
programme.desc: When various townsfolk report having lost soft belongings, TZG secretly investigates to discover thieving pigeon Yolanda had been building a nest for baby gophers. When Ians lucky badminton racket goes missing, TZG secretly finds and returns it in time for a rematch against his toughest opponent.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Grumblegard, Part 1

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Grumblegard, Part 2
programme.desc: The Rescue Riders plan to team up with the Slinkwings when an angry Grumblegard threatens Huttsgalor. But their old enemies may be up to new tricks.

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S2 - Doodlebook
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a cup of crayons and a coloring book with the same doodle on every page. But when CatRat gets stuck inside the book, Gabby and Pandy must go on a doodle rescue mission to save him.

programme.title: Gabbys Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Safari
programme.desc: Its time for a safari adventure in the dollhouse! For the COTD segment, Cakey and Parrot show us how to make adorable safari snacks.

programme.title: The Mighty Ones S2 - Twig Tat The Gnome

programme.title: The Mighty Ones S2 - Gherkin Returns This Blows

programme.desc: 第14集n薛姝令秦贵妃滑胎的计谋因雪蕙而事败，姚惜成替罪羊被贬出宫；谢危向圣上呈上燕家印信，提议将燕牧父子流放璜州，张遮认为谢危其心不正；雪宁在雪夜找谢危问清楚，不料目睹谢危离魂症发作杀公仪丞，谢危向雪宁举刀.

programme.title: 六点半新闻报导 世界观 今日知多D News At 18:30 Global View Whats On Today
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报导本地两岸及国际重要新闻.

programme.title: 东张西望 Scoop 2026
programme.desc: 东张西望星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮今日突发环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家.

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: 第19集 猎鹰行动（上）n模型品牌EGO将举办全球宣传活动，冠一致力争取本地宣传项目前AI公司CEO Brian身败名裂后转战玩具界，骗取大量EGO绝版模型，企图藉举办玩具展牟暴利，却遭网民揭发黑历史唐芯等人发现该网民正是小栈住客杨光，原来他亦是苦主之一众人连手声讨Brian，Brian却反发律师信，拟控告杨光诽谤唐芯设法搜集Brian罪证，行动中却生变故另一边厢，杨帆竟与Brian合作，答应帮他对付唐芯等人.

programme.title: 夫妻的博弈 Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: 第24集n幸如纵记起车祸当晚经过，惜看不清司机容貌启荣暗中派人跟踪幸如家谦晓彤获苓君协助，取得加入东驲董事局竞选主席的资格，但这意味她要与家谦提早完婚幸如终恍然某事的真相，大受冲击；虽然如此，幸如仍对这事心存感恩继威向雪文示好，雪文以为继威知错，讵料幸如看不过眼苓君摆弄家人以至自己的人生，当众直斥其非.

programme.title: 大唐迷雾 The Tang Mist
铁子瓹山窿 Her Railway Trip
programme.desc: 第4集n倪嘉雯 寻找忍者列车身边全是狸猫nn据闻滋贺县有辆神出鬼没的列车，嘉雯决定一探究竟见到真身，但未能乘搭？唯有忍者上身，深入车库，登上停泊中的列车，慢慢欣赏忍者主题列车的一切细节nn信乐町一带驰名的还有狸猫，月台有过百只，站外还有只逾五米高的特大陶偶！山坡上亦建有不少窑洞，趁着下雨，嘉雯于窑内叹茶吃蛋卷，扫走雨天的郁闷nn嘉雯搭乘一人负责的列车往找陶艺体验导师，DIY一个集合多重寓意的狸猫摆设，不忘搜购狸猫手信，延续满满幸福感.

programme.title: 娱乐头条 EXTRA
programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报导艺人最新动态剧集和电影宣传演唱会精华颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌影视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息.

programme.title: 晚间新闻 News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港两岸国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 杀人无数的刽子手叶常绿黄德斌为保护恩公的媳妇阮素心姚子羚顺利产子，将素心安顿在京城享负盛名的稳婆花蕊红邵美琪家中，因而遇上离奇命案，常绿竟以其鬼头刀救活了一条小生命，谁料这名来历不明的男婴令常绿和蕊红无故卷入朝廷的政治漩涡，一冷一热的配搭化解了一次又一次的危机，两人在患难中渐生情愫；另边厢，一对同在妓院长大的小情侣赤知秋杨明和祝小满龚嘉欣来到蕊红家，苦苦哀求常绿收知秋为刽子手的学徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脱受刑，常绿迟疑不决，一名神秘的彩戏师司马丑陈山聪出现，令各人关系陷入错综复杂，男婴身分之谜更因而被逐步揭开，但同时敲起了死神的丧钟.

programme.title: 兄弟 Fist Fight
programme.desc: 来自英国的保镖主管夏天行杨明，到港后奉命保护网络教主张非凡王浩信，顺道寻觅身世线索非凡行事张狂，还藉举办拳赛掩护窃密黑客赴港，期间屡遇险境麻烦，幸得天行一一化解事件引来火爆刑警何铁男伍允龙关注，决心全力追查原来铁男曾因一时冲动犯下不可告人的过失，性格亦渐走偏锋拳赛同时激发三人的好战天性，他们又逐渐发现彼此拥有相同的感应能力，藉以互助互救而三人背后的隐密连系，更牵涉逾二十年前的金融风暴之战.

programme.title: 巨轮 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 乔天生（陈展鹏饰）和罗威信（萧正楠饰）是同母异父的亲兄弟，因为命运令他们不单分开在香港和澳门两地，更令他们尝尽剧变历史中的两极冲突 母亲周玉梅（李司棋饰）带着小儿子威信在澳门当黑市居民，威信凭着努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮饰）与龙飞（阮兆祥饰）的相助，历尽艰辛，克服挑战，最终踏上成功之路独自在港自食其力的天生却改走快捷方式，联结黑道古惑仔姜勇（张继聪饰），与富家女发生关系，令女友卓静（钟嘉欣饰）伤心欲绝，最终落得人财两空 本是唇齿相依的手足情，经历时代巨轮的洗礼，前境变幻莫测，二人愈走愈远，但一个信念深植在他们相连的血脉里，纵然考验再苦再难，终在一条又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 妳不是她 Youre Just Not Her
programme.desc: 食品公司销售经理林信丁子朗饰时装店老板夏莉冯盈盈饰同居多时，爱情渐变平淡，两人对将来也存在分歧情侣间日积月累的矛盾不满一发不可收拾，林信夏莉爆发激烈争吵下引致车祸经历生死一剎后，踏实贤淑的夏莉变得热情率性，事事以林信为中心，甚至介入其圈子，为林信的姊姊林善车婉婉饰上司麦美娜姚嘉妮饰竞敌骆伟滔张颕康饰好兄弟穆家杰马贯东饰和区文黄庭锋饰带来巨大冲击！林信纵跟夏莉重拾初相识的浪漫与情愫，但眼前的她犹如判若两人，林信不禁思疑对方还是否真爱？.

programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 妳不是她 Youre Just Not Her
programme.desc: 食品公司销售经理林信丁子朗饰时装店老板夏莉冯盈盈饰同居多时，爱情渐变平淡，两人对将来也存在分歧情侣间日积月累的矛盾不满一发不可收拾，林信夏莉爆发激烈争吵下引致车祸经历生死一剎后，踏实贤淑的夏莉变得热情率性，事事以林信为中心，甚至介入其圈子，为林信的姊姊林善车婉婉饰上司麦美娜姚嘉妮饰竞敌骆伟滔张颕康饰好兄弟穆家杰马贯东饰和区文黄庭锋饰带来巨大冲击！林信纵跟夏莉重拾初相识的浪漫与情愫，但眼前的她犹如判若两人，林信不禁思疑对方还是否真爱？.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 杀人无数的刽子手叶常绿黄德斌为保护恩公的媳妇阮素心姚子羚顺利产子，将素心安顿在京城享负盛名的稳婆花蕊红邵美琪家中，因而遇上离奇命案，常绿竟以其鬼头刀救活了一条小生命，谁料这名来历不明的男婴令常绿和蕊红无故卷入朝廷的政治漩涡，一冷一热的配搭化解了一次又一次的危机，两人在患难中渐生情愫；另边厢，一对同在妓院长大的小情侣赤知秋杨明和祝小满龚嘉欣来到蕊红家，苦苦哀求常绿收知秋为刽子手的学徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脱受刑，常绿迟疑不决，一名神秘的彩戏师司马丑陈山聪出现，令各人关系陷入错综复杂，男婴身分之谜更因而被逐步揭开，但同时敲起了死神的丧钟.

programme.title: 兄弟 Fist Fight
programme.desc: 来自英国的保镖主管夏天行杨明，到港后奉命保护网络教主张非凡王浩信，顺道寻觅身世线索非凡行事张狂，还藉举办拳赛掩护窃密黑客赴港，期间屡遇险境麻烦，幸得天行一一化解事件引来火爆刑警何铁男伍允龙关注，决心全力追查原来铁男曾因一时冲动犯下不可告人的过失，性格亦渐走偏锋拳赛同时激发三人的好战天性，他们又逐渐发现彼此拥有相同的感应能力，藉以互助互救而三人背后的隐密连系，更牵涉逾二十年前的金融风暴之战.

programme.desc: 杀人无数的刽子手叶常绿黄德斌为保护恩公的媳妇阮素心姚子羚顺利产子，将素心安顿在京城享负盛名的稳婆花蕊红邵美琪家中，因而遇上离奇命案，常绿竟以其鬼头刀救活了一条小生命，谁料这名来历不明的男婴令常绿和蕊红无故卷入朝廷的政治漩涡，一冷一热的配搭化解了一次又一次的危机，两人在患难中渐生情愫；另边厢，一对同在妓院长大的小情侣赤知秋杨明和祝小满龚嘉欣来到蕊红家，苦苦哀求常绿收知秋为刽子手的学徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脱受刑，常绿迟疑不决，一名神秘的彩戏师司马丑陈山聪出现，令各人关系陷入错综复杂，男婴身分之谜更因而被逐步揭开，但同时敲起了死神的丧钟.

programme.title: 兄弟 Fist Fight
programme.desc: 来自英国的保镖主管夏天行杨明，到港后奉命保护网络教主张非凡王浩信，顺道寻觅身世线索非凡行事张狂，还藉举办拳赛掩护窃密黑客赴港，期间屡遇险境麻烦，幸得天行一一化解事件引来火爆刑警何铁男伍允龙关注，决心全力追查原来铁男曾因一时冲动犯下不可告人的过失，性格亦渐走偏锋拳赛同时激发三人的好战天性，他们又逐渐发现彼此拥有相同的感应能力，藉以互助互救而三人背后的隐密连系，更牵涉逾二十年前的金融风暴之战.

programme.title: 巨轮 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 乔天生（陈展鹏饰）和罗威信（萧正楠饰）是同母异父的亲兄弟，因为命运令他们不单分开在香港和澳门两地，更令他们尝尽剧变历史中的两极冲突 母亲周玉梅（李司棋饰）带着小儿子威信在澳门当黑市居民，威信凭着努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮饰）与龙飞（阮兆祥饰）的相助，历尽艰辛，克服挑战，最终踏上成功之路独自在港自食其力的天生却改走快捷方式，联结黑道古惑仔姜勇（张继聪饰），与富家女发生关系，令女友卓静（钟嘉欣饰）伤心欲绝，最终落得人财两空 本是唇齿相依的手足情，经历时代巨轮的洗礼，前境变幻莫测，二人愈走愈远，但一个信念深植在他们相连的血脉里，纵然考验再苦再难，终在一条又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan cool di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: UsopWilchaMehghonjangMakhlukMuzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Her Railway Trip
programme.desc: Japans railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname Tetsuko meaning railway girl. The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether youre a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, Tetsukos Lofty Mountain offers a romantic and surprising railway journey.

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Want To De-stress
programme.desc: Many urban dwellers are constantly striving for a living and a career, leaving no time for relaxation. The accumulated stress can quickly trigger health problems. This program invites professionals from various fields, such as aromatherapists, music therapists, color therapists, nutritionists, and psychologists, to use accessible methods, including case studies and fun quizzes, to bring out the harmony and balance of the five senses, helping viewers instantly release stress. Celebrities will also be invited to have candid conversations with the host, sharing their effective methods for coping with the heavy pressures of life and work. The program also includes many interesting stress-reduction tips to deepen viewers understanding of the importance of stress reduction for health.

programme.title: Another Era
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG Kwok Chun On saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAMs Wu Fung business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG Pat Poon. Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONGs son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU Chow Lai Ki, Niki, with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT Frankie Lam, faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANGs wife CHEUNG MING-HEI Tavia Yeung, CHUNG-YAMs grandson FONG CHAK-YU Benjamin Yuen and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI Chau Pak Ho also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Her Railway Trip Whats On Today
programme.desc: Japans railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname Tetsuko meaning railway girl. The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether youre a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, Tetsukos Lofty Mountain offers a romantic and surprising railway journey.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU SIT KA YIN, NANCY met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI KWOK FUNG and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO SHEH CHARMAINE and her adopted child, MAN CHOR CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN. Having been abandoned by her lover, CHORs mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING TONG MICHAEL. CHORs voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HOs future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HOs heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Her Railway Trip Whats On Today
programme.desc: Japans railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname Tetsuko meaning railway girl. The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether youre a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, Tetsukos Lofty Mountain offers a romantic and surprising railway journey.

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestantsHo Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-szeset aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various outdoor experts on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong wild women with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. programme.title: Shock Mystery Sr.2
programme.desc: Human beings are innately curious about the unknown. Some even believe that not everything in life can be explained solely by scientific or physical phenomena. Even when there appears to be an acceptable answer on the surface, it may not fully resolve all our questions. The production team of Shock Mystery has collected hundreds of strange and unusual cases from around the world, most of which cannot be explained from the perspectives commonly accepted by peopleunless supernatural phenomena truly exist in our world! This program will introduce you to incredible mysteries that not only existed in the past but still persist today!

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.
